title: Prove two 3-cycles with a spectator coordinate cost exactly twelve (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

**Exact computer-assisted result in a formal model. No new κ.** The selected frontier (#4610, κ = 15108879/5000000000) is unchanged.

This answers the n ≥ 4 open question of #5005 for its smallest case. In `M_2(F2[GL_4(F2)])`, take `c` the coordinate 3-cycle on coordinates 0, 1, 2, with address coordinate 3 a **spectator** (fixed by the endpoint, but writable by calls). There are 72 paid factors and free scalar maps.

```text
diag([c],[c]) has no realizing word of length ≤ 11, so its cost is exactly 12.
```

So a spectator coordinate gives two 3-cycles no shared work, matching n = 3 (#5005). The dirty-register direction is still open at length 11 (#5292). A single 3-cycle with spectators already costs 6 (#4974).

## Method

`search.c` is a **sparse** exact meet-in-the-middle engine. Each matrix entry is a sorted set of `GL_4(F2)` indices, with at most `2^L` terms after L calls, so no 20,160-bit dense states are needed.
- **Reductions.** Cancellation, an exact commutation normal form (1,584 commuting ordered pairs), and 36 target-fixing symmetries with orbit-least first pairs (142 of 5,112).
- **Exact check of key matches.** Every key match is tested exactly: distance ≤ 5 iff `X·B` lies in the stored 4,297-state radius-two ball for some word `|B| ≤ 3`.
- **Forward ball.** The counts at depth ≤ 1…5 are 73 / 4,297 / 240,565 / 13,231,207 / 721,626,127.

## Evidence

| Check | Where |
|---|---|
| Length ≤ 9 (4 + 5), plus all controls | registered replay, 17 s locally |
| Length ≤ 10 (4 + 6), 2.18·10⁹ backward nodes, 0 key matches | **local** receipt (`RESULT.json`) |
| Length ≤ 11 (5 + 6), 1 key match rejected exactly | **local** receipt, about 10 min on 16 cores, 8 GB |

The default verifier checks:
- compilation with `-Wall -Wextra -Werror`;
- an exact binding of the C products to the merged Python formal model at n = 4, R = 2 (36 random words);
- an engine self-test, including distance-5 verification of random words and rejection of the target;
- the state counts through depth 4;
- positive controls with and without symmetry: `diag(c,e)` and two swaps, each with nothing at length ≤ 5 and length 6 found;
- `diag(c, s01)`: nothing at length ≤ 8, with length 9 found in a local receipt;
- the 12-call word, checked in Python.

Tamper tests: changing `search.c` fails the hash binding, and dropping one generator column update fails the semantic binding.

**Disclosure.** My first length-11 run used a build whose exact check only reached distance 4, which is insufficient for forward depth 5. I discarded that run, fixed the check, added a distance-5 self-test, and reran. All recorded receipts come from the final source.

## Scope

Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope changed (`TASK.json`). Only n = 4, R = 2 is covered. The following remain open: all n ≥ 4 (the open question proposes a written-spectator reduction), R = 3, other targets, native operations, tariffs and κ.

Base: `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority revision 7.

Credit: #4939 (formal model), JoyboyBrian #4974 (single-cycle spectator theorem), and the predecessors of #4950/#4968/#5005/#5292.
